settings.heading: Bridal Enquiry
settings.intro: Congratulations on your engagement — I'd be honoured to be part of your wedding day.
settings.body: Maggie is an award-winning bridal makeup artist with several consecutive Australian Bridal Industry Awards, bringing years of professional experience and a calm, supportive approach to every bride. She listens closely to your vision and translates it into a personalised, timeless look that makes you feel confident and beautiful. Planning and getting ready can feel overwhelming — she'll guide you through trials, timelines and on-the-day styling to ensure a relaxed, memorable morning.

settings.heading: Bridal Enquiry
settings.subheading: Please provide the below information to receive Maggie's bridal offerings and book a consultation.
settings.note: We'll only use your details to reply to your enquiry. Bridal bookings can be cancelled up to 7 days before the appointment for a 12-month credit.
settings.success: Thank you — your enquiry is on its way. Maggie will be in touch shortly with her bridal offerings.
